description: P9-15, EV-108: a SYNTHETIC answer (written for this repository, not recorded from a model) to the check of the data model against the decision records (adr-model.v1) of the eShop plan of EV-95, whose ADR-001 decides "Hi-lo ids generated in the application": it names the three hi-lo sequences BR-006 names (catalog_hilo, catalog_brand_hilo, catalog_type_hilo), and catalog_brand, a table the model has, which is dropped. Source: the public eShopModernizing (MIT licence); no employer text.
